text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan (Perbekalan) 2018.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa

pada 1 Januari 2018.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2018

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi satu ratus dua puluh juta lima ratus

sembilan puluh ribu ringgit (RM120,590,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan daripada

Kumpulan Wang Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Sistem

Insurans Pekerjaan bagi tahun 2018 sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

 Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 17,945,285

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 7,351,715

Perbelanjaan lain RM 15,093,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan RM 80,200,000

Jumlah RM 120,590,000

Dibuat 24 Julai 2018

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)747/II]

M. KULA SEGARAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1) of

the Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance System

(Supply) Regulations 2018.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation

on 1 January 2018.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2018

2. A sum not exceeding one hundred and twenty million five hundred and ninety

thousand ringgit (RM120,590,000) shall be issued out of the Employment Insurance

Fund for expenditure on the administration of the Employment Insurance System for

the year 2018 as provided in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 17,945,285

Supplies and services RM 7,351,715

Other expenditures RM 15,093,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment RM 80,200,000

___________________

Total RM 120,590,000

Made 24 July 2018

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)747/II]

M. KULA SEGARAN

Minister of Human Resources
